basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: Auroline collects no data. There is no account and no analytics SDK. Your location is used on your device to compute your forecast.
onDevice: Your saved locations, alert thresholds and settings
Your forecast, which is calculated on your device
Alert schedules: alerts are scheduled on your device, with no server in between

permissions.name: Location
permissions.why: To work out your forecast for where you are. It is used on your device and is not uploaded to us.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.why: To send the aurora alerts you set up.

permissions.name: Background App Refresh
permissions.why: To check conditions and fire alerts while the app is closed.

services.name: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
services.what: Kp index, the OVATION auroral oval, solar wind and the three-day forecast. These are public data downloads.

services.name: Apple WeatherKit
services.what: Cloud cover for your position. Apple's weather service receives the location it needs to answer, under Apple's privacy policy.

purchases: Auroline Pro is sold through the App Store. Apple handles payment; we never see your card or Apple Account details.
